blocks.en: If our coefficients are smooth enough, we can put a general PDE into divergence form. We give conditions for doing so here which are sufficient, though by no means necessary.
blocks.zh: 若系数足够光滑, 可以将一般 PDE 写成散度形式. 这里给出实现这一转换的充分条件, 但这些条件绝非必要条件.

blocks.en:
We do the proof here for general $k$, but the notation is rather cumbersome, so the reader should work through the details for the case $k=1$.

For every $|\alpha|\leq2k$ we choose $\sigma_\alpha$ and $\gamma_\alpha$ satisfying $|\sigma_\alpha|,|\gamma_\alpha|\leq k$, $\sigma_\alpha+\gamma_\alpha=\alpha$. This choice is, of course, not unique.

Now, for any $u\in C^{2k}(\Omega)$ and $\phi\in\mathcal{D}(\Omega)$ we have\[\begin{aligned}
\int_\Omega L(\bm{x},D)u\,\phi\,\mathrm{d}\bm{x}
&=\sum_{|\alpha|\leq2k}\int_\Omega(D^\alpha u)a_\alpha\phi\,\mathrm{d}\bm{x}\\
&=\sum_{|\alpha|\leq2k}\int_\Omega(D^{\sigma_\alpha+\gamma_\alpha}u)a_{(\sigma_\alpha+\gamma_\alpha)}\phi\,\mathrm{d}\bm{x}\\
&=\sum_{|\alpha|\leq2k}(-1)^{|\sigma_\alpha|}\int_\Omega(D^{\gamma_\alpha}u)\bigl(D^{\sigma_\alpha}[a_{(\sigma_\alpha+\gamma_\alpha)}\phi]\bigr)\,\mathrm{d}\bm{x}\\
&=\sum_{|\alpha|\leq2k}(-1)^{|\sigma_\alpha|}\int_\Omega D^{\gamma_\alpha}u
\sum_{\rho\leq\sigma_\alpha}\binom{\sigma_\alpha}{\rho}D^{\sigma_\alpha-\rho}a_{(\sigma_\alpha+\gamma_\alpha)}D^\rho\phi\,\mathrm{d}\bm{x}\\
&=\sum_{\substack{|\alpha|\leq2k\\\rho\leq\sigma_\alpha}}(-1)^{|\sigma_\alpha|+|\rho|}\int_\Omega
D^\rho\left[\binom{\sigma_\alpha}{\rho}D^{\sigma_\alpha-\rho}a_{(\sigma_\alpha+\gamma_\alpha)}D^{\gamma_\alpha}u\right]\phi\,\mathrm{d}\bm{x}\\
&=: \sum_{0\leq|\sigma|,|\gamma|\leq k}\int_\Omega(-1)^{|\sigma|}D^\sigma(a_{\sigma\gamma}(\bm{x})D^\gamma u)\phi\,\mathrm{d}\bm{x}.
\end{aligned}\](Note that the last equality is a definition.) Since this holds for all $\phi\in\mathcal{D}(\Omega)$ we have our result.
blocks.zh:
这里对一般的 $k$ 给出证明, 但记号相当繁复, 因此读者应当在 $k=1$ 的情形下逐一验证细节.

对每个 $|\alpha|\leq2k$, 选取 $\sigma_\alpha$ 和 $\gamma_\alpha$, 满足 $|\sigma_\alpha|,|\gamma_\alpha|\leq k$, $\sigma_\alpha+\gamma_\alpha=\alpha$. 当然, 这种选取并不唯一.

现在对任意 $u\in C^{2k}(\Omega)$ 和 $\phi\in\mathcal{D}(\Omega)$, 有\[\begin{aligned}
\int_\Omega L(\bm{x},D)u\,\phi\,\mathrm{d}\bm{x}
&=\sum_{|\alpha|\leq2k}\int_\Omega(D^\alpha u)a_\alpha\phi\,\mathrm{d}\bm{x}\\
&=\sum_{|\alpha|\leq2k}\int_\Omega(D^{\sigma_\alpha+\gamma_\alpha}u)a_{(\sigma_\alpha+\gamma_\alpha)}\phi\,\mathrm{d}\bm{x}\\
&=\sum_{|\alpha|\leq2k}(-1)^{|\sigma_\alpha|}\int_\Omega(D^{\gamma_\alpha}u)\bigl(D^{\sigma_\alpha}[a_{(\sigma_\alpha+\gamma_\alpha)}\phi]\bigr)\,\mathrm{d}\bm{x}\\
&=\sum_{|\alpha|\leq2k}(-1)^{|\sigma_\alpha|}\int_\Omega D^{\gamma_\alpha}u
\sum_{\rho\leq\sigma_\alpha}\binom{\sigma_\alpha}{\rho}D^{\sigma_\alpha-\rho}a_{(\sigma_\alpha+\gamma_\alpha)}D^\rho\phi\,\mathrm{d}\bm{x}\\
&=\sum_{\substack{|\alpha|\leq2k\\\rho\leq\sigma_\alpha}}(-1)^{|\sigma_\alpha|+|\rho|}\int_\Omega
D^\rho\left[\binom{\sigma_\alpha}{\rho}D^{\sigma_\alpha-\rho}a_{(\sigma_\alpha+\gamma_\alpha)}D^{\gamma_\alpha}u\right]\phi\,\mathrm{d}\bm{x}\\
&=: \sum_{0\leq|\sigma|,|\gamma|\leq k}\int_\Omega(-1)^{|\sigma|}D^\sigma(a_{\sigma\gamma}(\bm{x})D^\gamma u)\phi\,\mathrm{d}\bm{x}.
\end{aligned}\](注意, 最后一个等式是一个定义.) 由于这对所有 $\phi\in\mathcal{D}(\Omega)$ 成立, 所需结论得证.

blocks.en: Unless explicitly stated otherwise, we shall assume that our coefficients satisfy the smoothness assumptions \eqref{eq:divergence-conversion-higher-coefficient-smoothness} and \eqref{eq:divergence-conversion-lower-coefficient-continuity}.
blocks.zh: 除非另有明确说明, 均假设系数满足光滑性假设 \eqref{eq:divergence-conversion-higher-coefficient-smoothness} 和 \eqref{eq:divergence-conversion-lower-coefficient-continuity}.
